prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite-sheet VFX for Mochi Mayhem, an original cute confectionery fantasy top-down mobile action game. Spectacular Japanese action-animation energy, bold dark navy ink contours, woodblock-inspired curling water lines, graphic flame brushwork, glossy candy-colored highlights, hand-painted cel-shaded shapes. Crisp readable silhouettes, not photorealistic smoke. Genuine transparent RGBA background, NO checkerboard, NO opaque backdrop, NO text, labels, numbers, grid lines, UI, people, weapons held by people, or watermark. Landscape 1536x1024 composition, EXACTLY SIX EQUAL COLUMNS and FOUR EQUAL ROWS (24 square cells). Each row is ONE six-frame animation read left-to-right; each cell contains exactly one isolated animation frame. All effects must stay completely inside their own cell with at least 12% empty transparent padding; use consistent scale and anchor within a row. Each frame must actually change painted internal shapes, not merely translate/rotate a duplicated still. Do not draw multiple ghost poses in a cell. Frame transitions should read smoothly. Large bright effect edges with open negative space; do not paint solid white disks. ROW 1: Steam Cannon facing RIGHT, emission anchored near left-center of each cell. Six phases: compact hot orange-gold pressure knot; coiling white steam ignition; wide explosive fan of creamy white steam with amber-hot core and crisp blue-grey ink curls; churning powerful fan; curling mist aftermath; thin dissipating wisps. It must look like a fierce hot steam blast, not fireballs or ground spikes. ROW 2: Tidal Serpent, an elegant fierce-but-cute turquoise WATER DRAGON made from fluid ribbons and foam, short horns and whiskers, bold navy outlines, facing RIGHT. Six distinct readable phases: coiled travelling serpent; body flexes and head lifts; jaw opens in preparation; forceful forward biting lunge; coiling recoil with foam; trailing water splash. Keep the same dragon identity and mostly stable head/body proportions across frames. ROW 3: Tidal Armor, translucent azure round water shield seen at a slight top-down angle, mostly empty transparent center for a small hero. Six looping phases of ripples flowing around the same outer outline; glistening foam edges, protective shell, no person. ROW 4: Mistwalk Aegis, cyan-white crescent wake and sweeping water ribbons seen from above, six flowing animation phases, same general footprint, fluid movement with negative space. All four rows belong to the same original illustrated game VFX family.
